lines: yah hamaare mitr parivaar ka ek chhota sa yaatra sansmaran hai. jo aksar mujhe yaad aata rahata hai.

baat kareeb 15 varsh puraanee hai. munbaee men vaashee men hamaara ek mitr parivaar rahata hai. peshe se ve chaartard akaauntent hain. unakee patnee mridubhaashee aur milanasaar grihanee hain. unakee keval ek hee betee hai. avval darje kee medhaavee aur pratibhaavaan. apanee medha ke bal par usaka poona ke medikal kolej men daakhila ho gaya. khabar sunakar parivaar vaale aur ham mitr gan khushee se phoole naheen samaae.

munbaee ke paas hee prasiddh shani shinganaapur dhaam hai. jahaan yah parivaar aksar jaaya karata tha. betee kee itanee badaee upalabdhi ke baad unhonne vahaan jaane ka nishchay kiya. agale shanivaar maan,pita aur betee teenon hee taiksee karake shani shinganaapur dhaam kee or chal padae. taiksee vaale se unhonne pahale hee kah diya ki vah is taiksee men any savaaree naheen baithaaega. lekin raaste men aur savaaree milane par vah taiksee vaala use baithaane lag gaya. inhonne virodh kiya lekin vah maana nahee. phal svaroop yah parivaar beech raaste men hee utar gaya. badaee pareshaanee ke baad inhen doosaree taiksee milee. yah us men baith kar gantavy kee or chal padae. thodaa sa aage badhae to ek jagah sadak par bahut bheed lagee huee thee.

unhonne jo drishy dekha to unake rongate khadae ho gae. yah vahee taiksee thee jo unhonne thodaee der pahale chhod dee thee. usamen koee bhee vyakti jeevit naheen bacha tha. saamane aate hue ek trak se usakee jabaradast takkar ho gaee thee. jisase vah taiksee pooree tarah kshatigrast ho gaee thee.

yah drishy dekhakar ve teenon hakke bakke rah gae; unahen aisa prateet hua jaise is durghatana se bachaane ke lie hee shani mahaaraaj ne unase vah taiksee chhudava dee thee. raaste bhar unaka man avasaad aur shraddha donon se hee bhara raha.
